name: Nazj'vel
summary: Nazj'vel is a coastal cavern and settlement carved into the shoreline far south along Darkshore's Twilight Shore. Inhabited by the serpentine naga, the rocky outcropping serves as a base for their incursions along the misty Kalimdor coast.

sections.title: A Serpent Enclave
sections.body: Situated off the far southern reaches of Darkshore along the Twilight Shore, Nazj'vel is a coastal sanctuary established by the naga. Emerging from the deep ocean trenches, these serpentine descendants of the ancient Highborne have claimed the caverns and shoreline ruins for themselves, threatening any travelers or night elf sentinels who venture south toward the border with Ashenvale. The damp caves echo with the chanting of their priestesses, making it one of the most perilous points along the western coast.

faq.answer: Nazj'vel lies far to the south along Darkshore's coastline, situated just off the edge of the Twilight Shore before reaching the southern borders of the region.
The caverns and surrounding waters of Nazj'vel are firmly in the hands of the naga, who defend their outpost against any land-dwellers who stray too close.

faq.q: Why are the naga here in Darkshore?
faq.answer: The naga have established strongholds along various coasts of Kalimdor, scavenging sunken ruins, recovering ancient relics of their former empire, and harassing night elf settlements.

angles.text: For the night elves of Darkshore, Nazj'vel is a bitter reminder of the Highborne's tragic descent and an active menace along the region's southern borders.
